origin: Derived from the retained native TRELLIS.2 head; no manual editing

surface.method: 26 exterior depth/color views; deterministic local filtering and oriented fusion
surface.color_space: sRGB in cloud; linear-light voxel averaging
surface.source_frame: Unscaled native TRELLIS Z-up unit cube

reconstruct.method: Exterior oriented screened Poisson + adaptive QEM; no manual edits
reconstruct.limitation: A derived surface, with possible feature loss; no facial deformation-loop guarantee

bake100k.method: xatlas + native surface-neighbor componentwise color median
bake100k.masks: Approximate color-based material regions; dark mask also includes brows/eyes. No semantic ground-truth claim.
bake100k.material: Conventional lit PBR; uniform roughness .85, metallic 0; no normal map

bake40k.method: xatlas + native surface-neighbor componentwise color median
bake40k.masks: Approximate color-based material regions; dark mask also includes brows/eyes. No semantic ground-truth claim.
bake40k.material: Conventional lit PBR; uniform roughness .85, metallic 0; no normal map

quad.method: QuadriFlow on reconstructed surface; no manual edits
quad.limitation: Automatic quad flow does not guarantee facial deformation loops

quad_bake.method: xatlas + native surface-neighbor componentwise color median
quad_bake.masks: Approximate color-based material regions; dark mask also includes brows/eyes. No semantic ground-truth claim.
quad_bake.material: Conventional lit PBR; uniform roughness .85, metallic 0; no normal map

masks.method: Automatic color prompts + eight-view SAM2 + visibility-weighted UV fusion
masks.limitations: Approximate palette-prompted masks; gold regions protect features and unknown surfaces. Inspect before reuse.

mask_views.limitation: Automatically prompted masks, not semantic ground truth

full_paint.method: Automatic color prompts + eight-view SAM2 + visibility-weighted UV fusion
full_paint.limitations: Approximate palette-prompted masks; gold regions protect features and unknown surfaces. Inspect before reuse.

limitations: Derived geometry changes the original surface; subsequent atlas/paint preserves each ordered reduced triangle.
Automatic fragmented UV atlas, not an artist-authored facial unwrap.
SAM2 regions are conservative palette-prompted masks, not ground-truth anatomical segmentation.
No production rigging or same-reference Tripo comparison; lower quality than Tripo.
